High.title: The global fixture set is discovered dynamically and is not identity- or digest-bound
High.context: run_fixtures() executes the current glob result and report() treats all returned fixtures as the complete required set. The verifier does not assert the exact 12 filenames, exact operation and expected-error mapping, operation uniqueness, per-fixture hashes, or the current fixture-set digest dd4595f8976843ca34a833311d6508a7a4f33203f10d940cd9f827049ab45245. GX-03 deletes the repaired duplicate-caller fixture and still returns a passing 11-fixture final status. GX-04 preserves the count at 12 but repurposes that fixture as a second bad_disposition case and still returns a passing final status. The global truth receipt likewise does not bind a required fixture manifest or fixture-set digest.
High.required_remediation: Add an immutable required-fixture manifest to the verifier, keyed by exact filename with exact SHA-256, operation, and expected_error_code. Before mutation dispatch, require exact set equality, count 12, unique required operations, exact metadata, and exact digest dd4595f8976843ca34a833311d6508a7a4f33203f10d940cd9f827049ab45245. Bind that manifest or digest into both the global report and truth receipt. Add durable tests proving missing, extra, renamed, duplicated-operation, repurposed-operation, expected-code-drift, and fixture-byte-drift cases fail before producer verification. Then replay twice and obtain a fresh independent global review.

decision.scope: The corrected Phase 4 global reconciliation is not ready for root project and product-owner acceptance.
decision.next_authority: Bounded verifier and global truth-receipt fixture-manifest remediation followed by a fresh independent global review.
